outcome_variable_scope: Variance decomposition of the own-minus-donor attribution interval into a donor-draw component and everything else, using components measured in r88 and r90 and a scaling law verified in r89. No new data.
scope: The SHARE is algebraically exact and n-invariant. The ABSOLUTE half-widths at 60 prompts extrapolate past r89's verified 300-968 range, so the transfer claim rests on the share and the frame-size numbers are estimates. It also assumes H_fresh's estimator matches the release's; whether its variance components are the same is measurable only from its data.
verdict: I INVARIANT. Entry 178 found r91's '5.3x the join' quoted into a document whose experiment holds 60 prompts. The audit that followed found seven release-scale rounds cited in the preregistration, and this checks the other one that became a binding REQUIREMENT rather than a description -- donor-averaging at m>=10 -- because a requirement inherited from the wrong population is worse than a number, it is an instruction. THE SHARE IS N-INVARIANT: the donor component and the prompt-sampling component both carry 1/sqrt(n), so their ratio cancels and the donor draw is 20.1% of the attribution variance at n=968 and 20.1% at n=60, a spread of 8.3e-17 across the range. So the requirement TRANSFERS -- but for a reason that is not obvious and was worth checking rather than assuming, since both absolute sizes grow by a factor of 4.0 while the share does not move. QUANTIFIED AT THE FROZEN FRAME, which is what the preregistration should state instead of the release's figures: the unaveraged half-width is 0.0493, m=10 gives 0.0446 (9.5% better) and m=100 gives 0.0441 (10.5%). So m=10 captures most of the available gain at the frame size too, and the diminishing return arrives in the same place. POSITIVE CONTROL: the scaling step recovers r89's MEASURED donor sd at n=300 to within 4.3%, inside r89's own 11.5% band -- a law that could not reproduce a measured value would make everything extrapolated from it inadmissible, and the round refuses to run in that case. DEGENERATE CONTROL: at m=1 the decomposition returns the unaveraged half-width exactly. SCOPE, and it is the honest limit: the SHARE is algebraically exact, but the ABSOLUTE sizes at n=60 extrapolate past r89's verified range of 300-968. The transfer claim rests on the share; the 0.0446 rests on the extrapolation and should be read as an estimate.
